purpose: Test a fixed corpus of historically or officially prominent UAP cases against hard evidentiary gates. The target is not 'unidentified' status; the target is a reproducible residual that retains anomalous physical performance after source, identity, calibration, uncertainty and prosaic-control checks.
epistemic_firewall: MISSING_RAW_DATA CANNOT BE REPLACED BY TESTIMONY

candidate_selection_rule.basis: Public cases with federal/official archival lineage and recurrent claims of multi-sensor or instrument-supported observation; selected as a stress-test corpus, not because any is assumed extraordinary.
candidate_selection_rule.no_posthoc_case_addition: No additional case may enter RESIDUAL-R1 after this prereg without becoming a new stage.

critical_gates.G0_PRIMARY_SOURCE_BIND: At least one primary official/federal source or authenticated official media artifact must be bound. Failure blocks promotion.
critical_gates.G1_INDEPENDENT_MODALITIES: At least two physically independent contemporaneous observation channels must be demonstrated; two witnesses using the same modality do not suffice.
critical_gates.G2_SHARED_OBJECT_IDENTITY: Evidence must support that the independent channels observed the same object/phenomenon within a defensible time-space association.
critical_gates.G3_CALIBRATED_MEASUREMENT: Public data must contain enough calibrated geometry/telemetry to estimate at least one physical parameter (range, speed, acceleration, altitude, size, trajectory) with explicit uncertainty. Narrative estimates alone fail.
critical_gates.G4_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROLS: Weather, astronomy, known aircraft/balloon traffic and relevant propagation conditions must be checked where applicable.
critical_gates.G5_SENSOR_ARTIFACT_CONTROLS: Relevant sensor/optical/radar/IR artifact mechanisms and platform motion/parallax must be evaluated.
critical_gates.G6_ROBUST_ANOMALOUS_KINEMATICS: At least one claimed performance feature must remain outside a conservative conventional envelope after uncertainty bounds and alternative geometries. If G3 fails, G6 is automatically NOT_TESTABLE.
critical_gates.G7_INDEPENDENCE_OF_EXTRAORDINARY_CLAIM: The extraordinary-performance conclusion must not depend solely on retrospective testimony, anonymous secondary retellings, or assumptions imported from another sensor stream.

promotion_rule.tier_B_unresolved_but_not_physical_anoma: PASS G0 and some observational gates, but G3/G6 fail or remain not testable
promotion_rule.tier_C_prosaic_or_artifact_supported: A specific ordinary explanation survives and accounts for the evidence at least as well as anomaly claim
promotion_rule.insufficient_public_data: Critical source/calibration/identity information is unavailable; must not be promoted to Tier A

stop_rule: RESIDUAL-R1 ends after all six frozen cases receive gate states. If zero cases pass G0-G7, report ZERO_PUBLIC_TIER_A_RESIDUALS_IN_FROZEN_CORPUS and do not add cases post hoc. Any new corpus is a separately preregistered stage.
claim_ceiling: A Tier A result would establish only a robust unexplained physical residual in public data. It would not establish extraterrestrial, nonhuman, adversary, time-travel, interdimensional or any other specific origin.
canonical_seal: THE TARGET IS NOT A STORY THAT REMAINS UNEXPLAINED. THE TARGET IS A MEASUREMENT THAT REMAINS PHYSICALLY ANOMALOUS AFTER THE ERROR BARS WIN EVERY ARGUMENT THEY CAN.
